question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of sentences with an underlined word followed by four words or group of words. Select the option that is opposite in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

My energy **__waned__** to see my college team performing poorly in the match.
solution:
The correct answer is "Grew."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Waned" means to become gradually weaker or less important. (क्षीण होना, कम हो जाना)

 
 
• Example:* My enthusiasm was **waning**__ rapidly.*
 
 
 
• ​The antonym of "Waned" is "Grew."
 
• The word "Grew" means** **to increase in size or number; to develop into an adult form. (आकार या संख्‍या की दृष्टि से बढ़ना; बड़ा होना)
 __
 
• Example:* The male deer **grew**__ large, branching horns called antlers.*
 
 
 
• ​So, the correct answer is Option 4.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Declined: **to become weaker, smaller or less good. ((किसी का) ह्रास होना, क्षीण होना)
 
• **Dimmed: **to become or make something less bright or clear. (धुँधला या अस्‍पष्‍ट हो जाना या कर देना)
 
• **Abated: **to become less strong; to make something less strong. (प्रकोप या प्रभाव का कम हो जाना या कम करना; धीमा होना)
